text: A bit is fundamentally a 1 or a 0.
explanation: A bit is a choice between two distinguishable states. In a wire it is two voltages, on a disk two magnetic orientations, on optical media a pit or a land, in flash memory trapped charge or its absence. Calling the states 1 and 0 is a naming convention we apply on top, and it is arbitrary — the same hardware works identically if you swap the names, which is what active-low signalling does.
